practice_book.title: A Night Signal · Practice Book
practice_book.reading_body_private_route: Insert the teacher-authorized reading-body image before the first reading exercise in a private project only.

exercises.title: English Definitions
exercises.instruction_en: Write the letter of the best definition beside each word.
exercises.instruction_cn: 在单词旁写出最合适释义的字母。
exercises.response_space: one short answer blank beside each word

exercises.title: Fixed Collocations
exercises.instruction_en: Complete each collocation with one word from the box. Use each word once.
exercises.instruction_cn: 用词框中的词完成搭配；每词只用一次。
exercises.response_space: one answer line inside each collocation

exercises.title: Words in Context
exercises.instruction_en: Complete the new-context sentences with the words in the box. Use each word once.
exercises.instruction_cn: 根据完整语境选词；每词只用一次。
exercises.response_space: six sentence blanks, including two blanks in item 4

exercises.title: Choose the Correct Form
exercises.instruction_en: Use the word in brackets in its correct form.
exercises.instruction_cn: 根据它在句子中的作用写出正确形式。

exercises.title: Find and Repair
exercises.instruction_en: Each sentence has one target-language error. Underline it and rewrite the whole sentence correctly.
exercises.instruction_cn: 每句只有一处目标语言错误；画出错误并改写完整句子。
exercises.response_space: one full-width rewrite line after every sentence

exercises.title: Combine the Ideas
exercises.instruction_en: Combine each set of ideas with the word or pattern in brackets. Keep the original meaning.
exercises.instruction_cn: 使用括号中的连接词或结构合并信息，不增加事实。
exercises.response_space: one full-width sentence line per item
exercises.example: The camera turned on. A light crossed the field. → When the camera turned on, a light crossed the field.

exercises.title: Change the Form
exercises.instruction_en: Rewrite each item with the required pattern without changing the meaning.
exercises.instruction_cn: 按要求改写表达方式，不改变原意。
exercises.response_space: one full-width sentence line per item

exercises.title: Build the Text
exercises.instruction_en: Put sentences A–F in a logical order. Then label the function of each step.
exercises.instruction_cn: 重组文章发展顺序，并判断每一步的功能。

exercises.title: Summary Cloze
exercises.instruction_en: Complete the summary. One word is extra.
exercises.instruction_cn: 根据文章逻辑和搭配完成概要；有一个多余词。
exercises.response_space: eight numbered blanks inside one summary

exercises.title: Mixed Review
exercises.instruction_cn: 每题只有一个最佳答案。
exercises.response_space: options on the same line as each item

exercises.title: Check the Evidence
exercises.instruction_en: Read the new case. Write S if a claim is supported and NS if it is not supported. Repair the unsupported claims.
exercises.instruction_cn: 判断文本是否支持每个说法，并修正不受支持的说法。
exercises.response_space: one verdict blank per claim plus three numbered repair lines

exercises.title: Short Report
exercises.instruction_en: Write four sentences: evidence, simplest idea, another possibility, and one unknown point.
exercises.instruction_cn: 分别写出证据、最简单解释、另一种可能和一个未知点。

teacher_answers.ANS-PB01: signal–a message or sign; direction–the way something moves or points; theory–an idea that explains facts; possibility–something that may be true; evidence–information supporting a claim; explain–make something clear.
teacher_answers.ANS-PB02: change direction; send a signal; suggest a theory; another possibility; supporting evidence; explain the change.
teacher_answers.ANS-PB03: 1 surprising; 2 direction; 3 signal; 4 sure exactly; 5 Perhaps.
teacher_answers.ANS-PB04: Accept the context-required forms: surprising/surprised, strangely, exactly, explain, possible, considered.
teacher_answers.ANS-PB05: Each response must repair the one target error and reproduce a complete grammatical sentence.
teacher_answers.ANS-PB06: Accept accurate combinations using the specified connector or pattern without adding facts.
teacher_answers.ANS-PB07: Accept meaning-preserving transformations with complete clauses and the required form.
teacher_answers.ANS-PB08: Observation → first explanation → new evidence → result → alternative theory → unknown point.
teacher_answers.ANS-PB09: camera, direction, signal, theory, evidence, possibility, sure, mystery; one stated extra word.
teacher_answers.ANS-PB10: One correct option per item; choices test tense, form, connector, modal, and passive accuracy.
teacher_answers.ANS-PB11: The key must identify three unsupported claims and repair each so it matches only the supplied case.
teacher_answers.ANS-PB12: Four sentences must perform the four stated functions. Reject invented evidence or a possibility written as a proved fact.

lessons.title: What Did the Camera Record?
lessons.purpose: Build a first understanding of the event and separate evidence from explanation.
lessons.success_evidence: Each learner records one gist choice, two evidence phrases, and five support judgments.
lessons.materials: Electronic reading body, Practice Book, board, highlighters
lessons.preparation: Display only the title and image before the first read; keep the body hidden until the reading purpose is set.

stages.title: One Light, Three Explanations
stages.teacher_move_cn: 只展示夜间光点图片，让学生先写一个观察和一个可能解释，再与同伴比较两者区别。
stages.ready_to_say_en: Write one thing you can see and one thing that might explain it. Do not turn the idea into a fact.
stages.student_action: Write one observation and one possible explanation, then compare the difference with a partner.
stages.individual_evidence: Every learner has one observation and one possibility.
stages.check: Sample two pairs and ask which statement can be proved from the image.
stages.anticipated_response: The light is long; perhaps it came from a drone.
stages.likely_error: Learners state a guess as a fact.
stages.recovery_move: Add can see versus may be on the board and recast one example.
stages.transition: Set the first-read purpose: find what the camera actually recorded.
stages.board_display: Board two columns: Evidence / Possible explanation.

stages.title: Read for the Event
stages.teacher_move_cn: 给出三个 gist 选项，限时默读，不解释词汇。
stages.ready_to_say_en: Read once. Choose what the whole text is mainly trying to explain.
stages.student_action: Read once and choose the best gist.
stages.individual_evidence: Every learner circles one option before discussion.
stages.check: Ask for the paragraph purpose supporting the choice.
stages.anticipated_response: The text reports a strange light and several explanations.
stages.likely_error: Learners choose an interesting detail as the gist.
stages.recovery_move: Compare which option covers the beginning, middle, and end.
stages.transition: Reread to separate observed information from theories.
stages.board_display: Keep only the three gist options visible.

stages.title: Shortest Proof
stages.teacher_move_cn: 让学生为三个说法找最短证据，先个人画线，再两人比较是否抄得过长。
stages.ready_to_say_en: Underline the shortest words that prove each claim. A whole sentence is usually too much.
stages.student_action: Underline the shortest proof for three claims and justify one choice.
stages.individual_evidence: Each learner marks all three phrases before pairing.
stages.check: Reveal one phrase at a time and compare precision.
stages.anticipated_response: changed direction twice; perhaps; nobody is sure exactly
stages.recovery_move: Cross out words that do not change the proof.
stages.transition: Use the same distinction in a new short case.

stages.title: Supported or Not Supported
stages.teacher_move_cn: 完成 PB11。先独立判断，再要求同伴用案例中的词证明；最后改写三条不受支持的说法。
stages.ready_to_say_en: Write S or NS first. Then repair every NS claim so it says only what the case supports.
stages.student_action: Complete five judgments and repair three unsupported claims.
stages.product: Five verdicts and three repaired claims
stages.individual_evidence: Every learner completes all PB11 response spaces.
stages.check: Teacher adjudicates each verdict and accepts only source-supported repairs.
stages.anticipated_response: Three claims are unsupported and must be weakened or corrected.
stages.likely_error: Learners judge real-world possibility instead of text support.
stages.recovery_move: Ask: Which exact words in this case prove it?
stages.transition: Close with one fact, one possibility, and one unknown.
stages.board_display: Show S / NS and one repaired model after individual work.

stages.title: Three-Part Exit
stages.teacher_move_cn: 让每人写 evidence、possibility、unknown 各一条，收三份快速检查。
stages.ready_to_say_en: Write one fact from the text, one possible explanation, and one thing nobody knows yet.
stages.individual_evidence: Every learner submits or shows the response.
stages.check: Check that the possibility contains cautious language.
stages.anticipated_response: The camera recorded a long light; perhaps it was a drone; nobody knows exactly what it was.
stages.likely_error: The possibility is written with definitely.
stages.recovery_move: Replace definitely with perhaps or may.
stages.transition: Homework rebuilds the text's information order.

lessons.board_plan: Evidence / Possible explanation / Unknown; add only learner-proved phrases.
anticipated_errors: real-world possibility confused with text support

differentiation.access: Pre-highlight the paragraph for the first evidence claim and provide perhaps/may frames.
differentiation.extension: Require the shortest possible proof and explain why extra words are unnecessary.

homework.title: Rebuild the Explanation
homework.teacher_verification: Teacher checks the six-step order at the start of the next lesson.
homework.next_lesson_use: Pairs justify one disputed step before the answer is revealed.

lessons.title: Words and Sentences for Careful Explanations
lessons.purpose: Learn the active words, chunks, and sentence patterns needed to explain uncertain evidence.
objectives: Explain six active words in English
Use cautious explanation language in a new context
lessons.success_evidence: Each learner completes vocabulary, collocation, context, and sentence-combining work and writes one new explanation.
lessons.materials: Electronic reading body, Practice Book, board, six definition slips for optional relay
lessons.preparation: Mark the three source sentences and prepare one new school-sensor context for transfer.

stages.title: Closed-Book Retrieval
stages.teacher_move_cn: 不看书写出上一课的三类信息，并尝试回忆 signal、direction。
stages.ready_to_say_en: Without opening the book, write one evidence word and one cautious explanation word.
stages.student_action: Retrieve two words and one idea, then compare with a partner.
stages.check: Accept meaning first; correct spelling after retrieval.
stages.likely_error: Learners copy after opening the book too early.
stages.recovery_move: Keep books closed for 45 seconds and accept partial retrieval.
stages.transition: Return to the source sentences to make the language precise.

stages.title: Meaning and English Definitions
stages.teacher_move_cn: 逐句恢复意思，在词第一次出现处给英文释义和简短例子，再完成 PB01。
stages.ready_to_say_en: A theory is an idea that tries to explain facts. Which definition is evidence?
stages.student_action: Match six active words to English definitions and explain one match.
stages.check: Ask for the key word in each definition before revealing the answer.
stages.anticipated_response: Evidence is information that supports a claim.
stages.likely_error: Learners match theory and possibility by topic only.
stages.recovery_move: Contrast explains facts with may be true.
stages.transition: Move from meaning to the chunks the words normally use.
stages.board_display: Write only word + short English definition + one source chunk.

stages.title: Build the Chunks
stages.teacher_move_cn: 先完成 PB02，再用 definition relay 核对；团队只有在每人写完后才能答题。
stages.ready_to_say_en: Complete the chunk first. Then explain why the two words belong together.
stages.student_action: Complete six collocations and justify two pairings.
stages.product: PB02 collocations and two oral explanations
stages.individual_evidence: Every learner completes all six chunks before team play.
stages.check: Teacher awards points for an exact chunk plus a correct explanation.
stages.anticipated_response: supporting evidence; suggest a theory; another possibility
stages.likely_error: Learners produce grammatical but non-target combinations.
stages.recovery_move: Return to the source partner and compare meaning.
stages.transition: Use the words and chunks away from the reading.
stages.board_display: Group chunks under Evidence / Explanation / Uncertainty.

stages.title: New Context and Sentence Building
stages.teacher_move_cn: 完成 PB03 后选择 PB06 两题合并句子；要求解释词形或连接关系。
stages.ready_to_say_en: Use the whole sentence to choose the word. Then combine the ideas without adding a new fact.
stages.student_action: Complete six context blanks and two sentence combinations.
stages.individual_evidence: Every learner completes the selected items before pair comparison.
stages.check: Partners explain one choice; teacher confirms form and meaning.
stages.anticipated_response: sure exactly; Perhaps; after changing direction
stages.likely_error: Learners choose by part of speech without reading the whole context.
stages.recovery_move: Read the words before and after the blank and identify the needed meaning.
stages.transition: Write one independent explanation for a new sensor case.
stages.board_display: Model one complete new-context sentence, not a copied source sentence.

stages.title: One Careful Explanation
stages.teacher_move_cn: 给出新传感器案例，学生写一句证据和一句谨慎解释；抽三份判断是否把可能性写成事实。
stages.ready_to_say_en: Write one evidence sentence and one explanation sentence. Use perhaps, may, or could for the explanation.
stages.check: Teacher samples three responses and gives one precision correction.
stages.anticipated_response: The sensor changed direction twice. Perhaps the wind moved it.
stages.likely_error: The explanation uses a definite verb with no caution marker.
stages.recovery_move: Add perhaps, may, or could and reread the claim.
stages.transition: Homework delays form and repair work until after class.

activities.title: Definition Relay
activities.language_purpose: Retrieve exact English meanings and source chunks.
activities.grouping: teams of three after individual completion
activities.rules: One learner reads a definition, the team writes the word and one chunk, and the teacher checks before the next slip.
activities.individual_evidence: Each learner already completed PB01–PB02 and explains at least one pair.
activities.teacher_adjudication: One point for the exact word and one for a valid chunk; inaccurate chunks receive no point.
activities.fallback: Run the relay as a seated reveal-and-write challenge.

lessons.board_plan: Evidence / Explanation / Uncertainty; English definition, source chunk, and one new sentence for each active item.

differentiation.access: Provide definition key words and one complete chunk model before independent completion.
differentiation.extension: Require two target chunks in one coherent new-context explanation.

lessons.lesson_close: Collect one evidence sentence and one cautious explanation.

homework.title: Form, Repair, and Transform
homework.teacher_verification: Teacher uses three anonymous repairs for a closed-book error check next lesson.
homework.next_lesson_use: Learners correct one anonymous sentence, explain the form, and revise their own homework.

lessons.title: Retrieve, Rebuild, and Report
lessons.purpose: Retrieve active language, rebuild the explanation, and transfer the four discourse functions to a new case.
objectives: Use evidence and cautious explanation functions in a short report
lessons.success_evidence: Each learner completes mixed retrieval, a summary, and a rehearsed four-sentence report.
lessons.materials: Practice Book, board, six jigsaw sentence strips per group
lessons.preparation: Select three anonymous homework errors and prepare the new-case report check list.

stages.title: Closed-Book Repair
stages.teacher_move_cn: 展示三条匿名错误句，先独立改写，再开放练习册。
stages.ready_to_say_en: Repair all three sentences before you open the book. Rewrite each whole sentence.
stages.individual_evidence: Every learner writes all three corrections.
stages.check: Compare target form and meaning, not only spelling.
stages.anticipated_response: Correct word form, modal base form, and cautious claim.
stages.likely_error: Learners change the wrong word or omit the rest of the sentence.
stages.recovery_move: Name the target mechanic and require a complete rewrite.
stages.transition: Move from sentence precision to whole-text logic.
stages.board_display: Show errors first; reveal corrections after individual work.

stages.title: Mixed Language Review
stages.teacher_move_cn: 完成 PB10，要求同伴解释两题为何其他选项不成立。
stages.ready_to_say_en: Choose first. Then explain why one wrong option cannot fit the sentence.
stages.student_action: Complete eight items and explain two choices.
stages.product: PB10 answers and two oral explanations
stages.individual_evidence: Every learner circles all eight answers.
stages.check: Teacher checks one tense, one form, one modal, and one passive item.
stages.anticipated_response: Form and sentence structure justify the choice.
stages.likely_error: Learners choose from memory of a source phrase only.
stages.recovery_move: Identify what the blank describes, completes, or connects.
stages.transition: Use the same language to rebuild a complete summary.
stages.board_display: Record only common error patterns, not all answers.

stages.title: Summary and Function Jigsaw
stages.teacher_move_cn: 先独立完成 PB09，再给每组不同功能句条；专家讨论后混组排序并说明功能。
stages.ready_to_say_en: Complete the summary alone. In the jigsaw, place your sentence and explain its job in the text.
stages.student_action: Complete the summary, then order and justify six function strips.
stages.individual_evidence: Each learner completes PB09 and records the final six-function order.
stages.check: Teacher accepts the order only when each transition is justified.
stages.anticipated_response: Observation leads to explanation, evidence, result, another theory, and unknown.
stages.likely_error: Groups order by vocabulary overlap rather than logic.
stages.recovery_move: Ask what each sentence does, not which words repeat.
stages.transition: Transfer the four key functions to a new case.
stages.board_display: Build a six-step function line after group justification.

stages.title: Four-Sentence Report Rehearsal
stages.teacher_move_cn: 使用新案例规划四句报告；先静默写关键词，再两人复述并互相指出一处把可能性写成事实的问题。
stages.ready_to_say_en: Prepare four sentences: evidence, simplest idea, another possibility, and one unknown point. Rehearse twice.
stages.student_action: Plan four functions and rehearse the report twice.
stages.product: Four-function report notes and oral rehearsal
stages.individual_evidence: Every learner records four function notes and performs once for a partner.
stages.check: Partners flag invented evidence; teacher checks two reports.
stages.anticipated_response: Each sentence performs one stated function with cautious language.
stages.likely_error: Learners add a dramatic fact not present in the case.
stages.recovery_move: Delete any claim that cannot be underlined in the case.
stages.transition: Close with a teacher-verifiable report route for homework.
stages.board_display: Evidence / Simplest idea / Another possibility / Unknown.

stages.title: One-Minute Check
stages.teacher_move_cn: 随机抽查三人完成四句报告，其他学生在自己的关键词旁标出需要修正的一句。
stages.ready_to_say_en: Give your four-sentence report. Listeners, mark one sentence you would make more careful.
stages.student_action: Deliver or monitor a four-sentence report and mark one revision.
stages.product: Teacher-checked report or one revision note
stages.individual_evidence: Every learner has a report plan and a marked revision.
stages.check: Teacher records completion and one precision note for sampled reports.
stages.anticipated_response: A complete cautious report with no invented facts.
stages.recovery_move: Add Nobody is sure exactly... as the final function.
stages.transition: Homework writes and rehearses the final report for the next random check.

activities.title: Function Jigsaw
activities.language_purpose: Order explanation functions and justify transitions.
activities.materials: six function sentence strips per group
activities.rules: Experts decide the function of one strip; mixed groups build the sequence; every learner records the order before the teacher checks.
activities.individual_evidence: Every learner records all six functions and one transition reason.
activities.teacher_adjudication: A point is awarded only for correct order plus a valid function explanation.
activities.fallback: Use numbered desk packets without moving groups.

lessons.board_plan: Three anonymous repairs; six-step text function line; four-function report frame.
anticipated_errors: word form chosen without sentence role

differentiation.access: Provide the four report function labels and one cautious-language bank.
differentiation.extension: Require a second possible explanation and explain why evidence cannot prove either one.

lessons.lesson_close: Run a teacher sample of four-sentence reports and require one revision note from everyone.

homework.title: Final Four-Sentence Report
homework.teacher_verification: Teacher random-checks the written and rehearsed report at the start of the next lesson.
homework.next_lesson_use: Sampled learners report to the teacher; all learners revise one sentence after feedback.

language_coverage.meaning: A school camera recorded an unusual light near the science building.
language_coverage.grammar_pattern: simple past for a completed observation
language_coverage.teacher_notes: Keep the first reading focused on observable evidence rather than form.

language_coverage.meaning: The light changed speed and direction, creating surprising evidence.

vocabulary.english_definition: the way that something moves or points
vocabulary.source_context: Its speed and direction changed twice.
vocabulary.new_context_use: The model car changed direction near the wall.
The sensor recorded something surprising after dark.

language_coverage.grammar_pattern: past continuous for the observed action and simple past for changes
language_coverage.teacher_notes: Contrast what was moving with what changed; require a new sensor context.

language_coverage.meaning: Several explanations are possible, but the evidence does not prove one.

vocabulary.english_definition: an idea that tries to explain facts
vocabulary.source_context: Some students suggested a different theory.
vocabulary.new_context_use: The class suggested a theory about the broken sensor.

vocabulary.english_definition: something that may be true or may happen
vocabulary.new_context_use: A weak battery is another possibility.

vocabulary.source_context: The evidence did not prove either theory.
vocabulary.new_context_use: The time stamp is supporting evidence.

language_coverage.grammar_pattern: cautious explanation with perhaps, may, could, and unknown-point language
language_coverage.teacher_notes: Do not accept possibilities written as proved facts; end with an unknown point.
